description: This file defines the CellReferenceHelper class, which provides utility methods for managing and updating cell references within spreadsheets, such as adjusting references based on changes like row/column insertions or deletions.

classes.name: CellReferenceHelper
classes.description: A helper class to handle cell reference manipulations such as updating cell references relative to insertions, deletions, or shifts within ranges.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance with a reference point, number of columns, and rows.

methods.name: beforeCellAddress
methods.description: Returns the reference address before any updates.

methods.name: refreshRequired
methods.description: Checks if the references need to be refreshed based on new parameters.

methods.name: updateCellReference
methods.description: Updates a given cell reference based on the position and whether absolute referencing is included.

methods.name: cellAddressInDeleteRange
methods.description: Determines if a specified cell address falls within a deletion range.

methods.name: updateColumnReference
methods.description: Adjusts the column part of a reference based on the shift.

methods.name: updateRowReference
methods.description: Adjusts the row part of a reference based on the shift.
